question: Who is called upon to provide constant protection in all places?
premises: Mahalakshmi is addressed as possessing three powers.
The protection sought is universal in location.
The protection sought is continuous in time.
inference: Mahalakshmi, endowed with three powers, is invoked to always protect the practitioner everywhere.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the three powers is not specified.
plain_english: And may Mahalakshmi, endowed with the three powers, always protect me everywhere.
